definition.question: Define a faithful inverse of the reproduced author package.
definition.scope: Using the preserved historical launch/feedback records, current frozen host/driver and existing variant-feasibility report, specify exactly groups A, B and C below, the reference, changed bytes/state and invariants for R02–R06. Produce one exposure/contrast matrix with an explicit feasibility verdict for each of the five arms. No new model call or historical savings re-audit.

result.checked: One saved-source A/B/C exposure and five-arm contrast matrix; no generation.
result.finding: R02/R03/R04 and the full R06 inverse have existing source boundaries; isolated R05 lacks faithful per-operation B feedback with native writes. R04/R06 is a conditional custody contrast with A/B off.
result.limits: Design feasibility only, not a positive token effect or historical share; every provider observation still needs source/input qualification and admission.

definition.question: Does native write/tool availability explain behavior beyond the author contract?
definition.scope: One A-on/B-on/C-off initial-author screen, only if R01 identifies a faithful boundary that leaves A/B and required work intact. Group C is precisely defined below; do not label a different whole workflow a C-only effect. No faithful finite contrast means a recorded unqualified result, not permission to expand the task.

result.checked: Conditional C-only admission gate using the saved boundary matrix and qualified real-Git custody rejection; no provider observation.
result.finding: Native writes alone violate custody; accepting them only after the native turn changes B feedback timing. No faithful existing C-only boundary, so no R05 generation.
result.limits: No C-only token estimate or zero-effect claim. R04/R06 is conditional on A/B off; a new per-tool interception framework is outside this task.

definition.question: How do the already-positive C08/C25 pathways overlap with this package in the historical runs?
definition.scope: Use the saved H refresh/continuation inventories and the existing C08/C25 effect reports once. Map the actual affected response/history windows, any shared window and the differing reference populations. Produce one overlap/transfer table; do not add old percentages or rerun either single. If no valid historical transfer is available, record that exact limit. No generation.

result.checked: One saved H refresh/continuation history-window join and C08/C25/package population-transfer table; no generation or old token re-total.
result.finding: Fourteen H refresh inputs span nine author histories and intersect 121 distinct directive-interrupt turns: 106 usage-released, 14 resumed-output and one timeout. The separately measured C08/C25 effects have no justified additive historical transfer.
result.limits: History windows are not exact response-token attributions. W and H reference populations differ; C25 is long-wait versus normal WL, not Direct versus WL. The combined historical percentage remains unidentified.

definition.question: Does removing cohesive implementation-plus-tests publication increase work and tokens?
definition.scope: One A-off/B-on/C-on initial-author screen, compared with the corresponding saved all-on episode. Keep real host feedback and write custody fixed; restore the declared original test-first/work-unit obligations. Record submitted work units, actual failures/checks and complete recorded usage. This is not a repeat of the old production-cohesion wording-only screen.

result.checked: One admitted A-off/B-on/C-on visual initial-author screen. The original 900-second wall ended it; no continuation, retry or replacement.
result.finding: Real test-first and incremental publication activate; timeout leaves a 1,289,370-raw prefix and unknown tail.
result.limits: The saved all-on reference's developer input contains two additional skill descriptions (775 bytes); the new A/B host screens have the same shorter catalog as each other. Thus the intended A-only intervention is not the only historical input difference. An incomplete prefix, unknown tail and changed catalog prevent a qualified exact A-only causal contrast. No task quality inference or old baseline accounting revision is made.

definition.question: Does removing result-bound validation/completion guidance increase work and tokens?
definition.scope: One A-on/B-off/C-on initial-author screen. Keep the same host, real result bytes, author task and edit policy; vary the combined acceptance/check/handoff contract, including reporting guidance. Use a fresh prospectively qualified modified episode, not the previously confounded fork/reinjection trial. Record the actual next actions and usage.

result.checked: One admitted A-on/B-off/C-on episode, stopped by the resource-failure branch after 1.068679 seconds. The finite one-attempt scope is exhausted; no replacement is launched.
result.finding: Operator monitoring-publication failure stops before verified B exposure; no replacement.
result.limits: This is an operator setup failure, not evidence against B and not a provider-authentication failure. Exact empty usage is not assumed. A repaired replacement would be additional work requiring permission; it is not hidden inside this completed task.

definition.question: Do publication policy and feedback act jointly?
definition.scope: One A-off/B-off/C-on initial-author screen. Compare its actual operation/history chain with the saved all-on episode and any completed R02/R03 observations. Test the combined causal prediction, not a generic all-on reproduction. This joint screen may precede the single-group screens.

result.checked: One completed A-off/B-off/C-on visual author episode, with its actual operations, source/state receipts and distinct usage retained. No replay, control or replacement.
result.finding: Real RED-first publication plus post-GREEN validation/read-through occur; complete author costs 2,430,527 raw.
result.limits: Target activation and higher complete cost are observed. However, the reference's actual developer input contains two additional skill descriptions (775 bytes). This unintended catalog difference fails strict historical non-target equality, despite matching task/base instructions/model/effort and exact intended A/B spans. The single R03 attempt failed, and R02 is incomplete. Therefore this is a promising joint mechanism signal, not an isolated B estimate or qualified historical causal percentage. Initial-author scope excludes review/fix/integration offsets.

definition.question: Does reversing the complete A+B+C package restore the expensive behavior?
definition.scope: One A-off/B-off/C-off initial-author screen, with the exact group set frozen by R01. This is the whole-package inverse, not another all-on run. Include every actual rejection, check and missing tail. Where a group contrast is inseparable, label it as such rather than assigning independent percentages.

result.checked: One completed native initial-author episode using the original native task/prompt and workspace-write boundary. A/B/C are the declared whole package, not an ordinary full Direct control.
result.finding: Native RED-first implementation and further validation/repair complete at 2,312,888 raw; below the current R04 result.
result.limits: The same two skill descriptions are absent relative to the historical all-on reference. The workspace-write/native-tool permission change is part of the declared C package; it also enables the original project's network-access setting, unlike read-only custody. R06's automatic 81-byte trust section exactly explains global config drift when removed in memory, but does not restore the missing skill catalog. Consequently the saved-reference increase is not a qualified pure package effect or a historical attributable share. No complete-workflow offset or quality conclusion follows from this author-only screen.

definition.question: Does the strongest observed causal reversal survive a full workflow?
definition.scope: Apply the predeclared selection rule below to R02–R06. If eligible, exactly three fresh complete modified workflows of that one already-defined arm, with separate checkouts and artifacts, reviews/fixes/integration included. No normal controls, all-on reproduction, replacements or fourth run. If no arm has a qualified discriminating signal, save that decision and perform no batch; this does not reject the underlying hypotheses.

result.checked: One predeclared eligibility decision across R02–R06; no qualified arm and no batch admitted.
result.finding: No R08 generation. Positive package signals fail saved-reference non-target equality; B-only failed, C-only is unavailable, and the complete conditional custody contrast is in the opposite direction.
result.limits: No batch is not a refuted hypothesis. Repair and fresh screening need new authority; no full-workflow offset population exists.

definition.question: Are the new intervention observations valid evidence for their declared factors?
definition.scope: One audit of every R02–R06/R08 observation actually admitted, including failures and unlaunched scheduled identities: source/input invariants, intended intervention activation, distinct-response usage and missing tails. Reuse the existing auditor; do not rebuild old baseline accounting. Publish qualified/excluded-for-causal-inference status while retaining every outcome and cost.

result.checked: One source/input/activation and distinct-response audit of all four admitted screens with the existing native core, including failed and incomplete attempts; no baseline accounting replay.
result.finding: 69 distinct responses total 6,032,785 recorded raw; all 15 completed public/native invocations agree. Two unfinished tasks retain unknown charges. 89 source endpoints checked; owned trust drift is exactly qualified. Actual missing developer skill catalog excludes pure saved-reference causal contrasts.
result.limits: R03 has no verified delivered prompt or target activation; R02 lacks complete cost. Monitoring deviations and original flags remain. No historical error or attributable percentage is established.

definition.scope: For the R08 population and its fixed saved reference, join the recorded initial-author, review/fix and integration stages and their concrete work triggers. Produce one complete stage/offset table and source-linked work-shift assessment. If R08 was not run or incomplete, record unavailable full-workflow inference; do not invent a completion or rerun.

result.finding: Saved all-on work includes 4,308,399 initial-author raw and 14,236,905 later raw. Genuine review fixes and integration gates remain. No R08 population exists, so the new author contrasts cannot identify downstream compensation.
result.limits: No missing treatment stage is zero or imputed. Initial-author-only inverse outcomes do not establish whole-workflow saving or unchanged repairs.

result.finding: Accepted historical gap remains 16,390,849⅔–18,644,849⅔ raw/workflow (45.383421%–51.624357%). New pure package contrast, full-workflow offsets and common-target transfer are absent; causally explained combined share and residual are not established, not zero.
